name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell resting across your hips.
Plant your feet and drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, keeping your ribs down.
image_prompt_scene: With the upper back on a bench, a dumbbell across the hips and the knees bent.
